scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.format: prettier --write README.md package.json backend/package.json backend/jest.config.js "backend/src/**/*.js" "backend/tests/**/*.js" frontend/package.json frontend/vite.config.js frontend/index.html "frontend/src/**/*.{js,jsx,css}"
scripts.format:check: prettier --check README.md package.json backend/package.json backend/jest.config.js "backend/src/**/*.js" "backend/tests/**/*.js" frontend/package.json frontend/vite.config.js frontend/index.html "frontend/src/**/*.{js,jsx,css}"
